notes.title: Press Kit - Durga : The Lionhearted
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to share the official teaser for our debut title, DURGA, a heartfelt, story-driven RPG crafted by our indie game studio, Shivaansh ArtVision.

About the Game:
In Durga, players step into the journey of a fearless village girl navigating the mysteries and dangers of ancient Indian forests. Blending puzzle-solving with exploration and rich storytelling inspired by Indian mythology, Durga is a journey of survival, self-discovery, and cultural legacy.

This marks our first game, and as an Indian indie team passionate about storytelling and immersive experiences, we're excited to finally bring it to life.

📎 Press Kit (images, logo, details):
https://bit.ly/DurgaPresskit

We would be honored if you considered covering our game. If you need any additional assets or would like to speak with the team for an interview or feature, feel free to reach out.

Thank you for supporting indie developers!

Best regards,
Tushar Prajapati
Founder, CEO | Shivaansh ArtVision
